instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem: A client who completed a 10-day course of clindamycin has had 8 watery stools in the past 12 hours with abdominal cramping and a temperature of 100.6 °F (38.1 °C). The client is alert but weak. A stool assay is positive for C. difficile toxin. Complete the bow-tie diagram for the nurse's priority focus.

actions.label: A3
actions.text: Clean shared equipment with a facility-approved sporicidal disinfectant

actions.label: A4
